# Used only by envs with `framework = arduino, espidf` (the hybrid build).
# Envs on the plain `framework = arduino` (prebuilt) path never invoke CMake
# and ignore this file entirely.
#
# Auto-generated by PlatformIO the first time a hybrid env is built; the
# `project()` name is pinned here to `openevse_esp32_firmware` rather than
# committing PlatformIO's generated `project(<checkout-dirname>)` form, which
# would make the CMake project name depend on whatever directory a clone
# lands in. See .superpowers/sdd/2026-08-25-arduino-idf-component/spike-report.md §1.
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16.0)
include($ENV{IDF_PATH}/tools/cmake/project.cmake)
project(openevse_esp32_firmware)
